Welcome to Tarnmose

This is the official website of the Municipality of Tarnmose. Residents can find information about civil registration, certificates, waste collection, planning and other municipal services here.

Popular services

  • Copy of a birth certificate — request a certified copy of a birth certificate registered in Tarnmose.
  • Copy of a marriage certificate — certified copies from the marriage register.
  • Waste collection — collection days and bin charges.
  • Dog registration — register a dog kept in the municipality.

All services

The full list of municipal services is on the services page.

Latest news

Council announcements are published on the news page. Meeting minutes are held by the municipal council.
